name: NSMnum
breaks_up: an NSMnum (Narrow Small Model [numerating]): one that does a single job and answers with a kind, a span, an item, a number or codes, never with sentences, and leaves the decision to code; narrow is the size of its answer, not of the model
left_out: A model that writes. Anything that writes text is not an NSMnum, and an NSMnum never starts from such a model or is taught by one: an NSMnum answers with a kind, a span, an item, a number or codes, and code decides what follows. Also left out: what the NSMnum is for in the world, its name, and the keys, which stay with the person who keyed them.
note: NSMnum stands for Narrow Small Model (numerating); num is for numerating, because all this kind of model does is name a number: of a passage, of an item on a list written in advance, or none. I changed its short form from NSM to NSMnum on 15 November 2026 to avoid a collision: NSM is already the Natural Semantic Metalanguage, Anna Wierzbicka and Cliff Goddard's theory of meaning in linguistics, and the other short forms I tried were taken too. The same day the full name, until then Narrow Small Model, became Narrow Small Model (numerating), so that each part of NSMnum stands for a word. NSMnum is both singular and plural, written and said the same: one NSMnum, three NSMnum, layers of NSMnum, the nearest NSMnum already built; never NSMnums. Said aloud: en-ess-em-num (एन-एस-एम-नम), four syllables, the letters N, S and M and then num as in number, for one or many.

element_types.name: does
element_types.description: The one thing the model does. A larger task is split into steps first, each done by its own model or by code.

elements.name: sorts
elements.description: puts each thing it reads into one of a few kinds set in advance
elements.gives: It puts each thing it reads into one of a few kinds set in advance.

elements.name: points
elements.description: finds the part of what it reads that answers a question, or says there is none
elements.gives: It points at the part of what it reads that answers a question, or at nothing.

elements.name: matches
elements.description: says which item on a list written in advance the thing it reads goes with
elements.gives: It says which item on a list written in advance the thing it reads goes with.

elements.name: spots
elements.description: says which of a set of words or sounds recorded in advance occurred
elements.gives: It says which of the words or sounds recorded in advance occurred.

elements.name: scores
elements.description: gives each option a number, and code takes the highest
elements.gives: It gives each option a number, and code takes the highest.

elements.name: chooses
elements.description: picks codes from sets, one slot at a time
elements.gives: It picks codes from sets, one slot at a time.

elements.name: counts
elements.description: says how many of one kind of thing there are in what it reads
elements.gives: It counts how many there are.

elements.name: notices the unusual
elements.description: says how far what it reads is from the normal it learnt, so code can flag the odd case
elements.gives: It says how unusual this is against what it learnt as normal.

elements.name: a whole text

elements.gives: It reads a whole text, shortened to fit its window.

elements.gives: It reads a few numbers that describe a situation.

elements.name: yes or no

elements.gives: It answers yes or no, or none.

elements.name: a span

elements.gives: It answers with codes, which code turns back into words.

instances.name: ungli
instances.what: a builder: design a task as steps of NSMnum (Narrow Small Models [numerating]) and plain code, and read beside each model what the nearest models already built were measured to do and what their records say to check. Its name is from ungli rakhna, to put a finger on the exact spot, which is all a model here does
links: the ungli skill for Claude Code

small_tasks.name: A TA bill's journey dates
small_tasks.task: A travel allowance bill in a government office is paid for the days the tour was sanctioned for; any other day needs a sanction of its own. The dates the claimant typed are checked against the sanction order.

steps.does: Points at each journey date in the claimant's typed journey details, or at nothing.
steps.then: Reads each date it was pointed at and compares it with the first and last day of the sanction order. A date outside them, or a bill where it pointed at nothing, goes to the accounts clerk.

small_tasks.name: Purchase invoices against GSTR-2B
small_tasks.task: An accounts clerk claims input tax credit only on purchase invoices the suppliers have reported in their GSTR-1, so that they appear in GSTR-2B. Each invoice in the purchase register is matched with the GSTR-2B statement downloaded from the GST portal. No step needs a model.

steps.does: Matches each invoice in the purchase register with GSTR-2B by the supplier's GSTIN, the invoice number and the tax amount, and lists the ones that do not match for the clerk.

small_tasks.name: An RTI application sent to the right office
small_tasks.task: Under Section 6(3) of the RTI Act, an application asking for information another public authority holds is transferred to that authority within five days. The application is read for which authority holds what it asks for.

steps.does: Chooses, from the office's list of public authorities, the one that holds what the application asks for, or none.

code.code gives: something made from pieces written in advance

steps.then: If it chose this office, the application goes into the register of the office's Public Information Officer (PIO). If it chose another authority, code fills in the transfer letter written in advance. If it chose none, the PIO reads it.

small_tasks.name: A leave application against the attendance minimum
small_tasks.task: A student writes to ask for leave. Where the student's attendance would stay at or above the university's minimum, often 75 per cent of classes, the leave is recorded without anyone reading it.

steps.does: Points at the first and last day of the leave asked for, or at nothing.
steps.then: Counts the classes on those days from the timetable. If the student's attendance stays at or above the minimum, the leave is recorded; if not, it goes to the faculty member. If it points at nothing, the application goes back to the student.
